sre_commands.intro.title: StarRailExpress Command Reference
sre_commands.intro.desc: All commands registered by this mod, grouped by namespace. Permission levels: 2=OP, 3=Senior admin, 4=Server owner.
sre_commands.help.overview_hint: Click a category to expand, or run /sre:help <category>.
sre_commands.help.category_hint: Click a command to fill it into the chat box.
sre_commands.sre.help.name: Help
sre_commands.sre.help.desc: List all StarRailExpress commands by category; click a category to expand.
sre_commands.tmm.start.name: Start game
sre_commands.tmm.start.desc: Start the given game mode; optionally force all players to join and set a start delay (minutes).
sre_commands.tmm.stop.name: Stop game
sre_commands.tmm.stop.desc: Stop the currently running game; use force to stop it immediately.
sre_commands.tmm.config.name: Runtime config
sre_commands.tmm.config.desc: View and modify SRE/Harpy/Noelle config at runtime; supports reload, reset, setting the current round, or toggling auto train reset.
sre_commands.tmm.afk.name: AFK management
sre_commands.tmm.afk.desc: Manage the idle-detection system: reset the timer, view status, or set AFK time for yourself/others.
sre_commands.tmm.money.name: Coin
sre_commands.tmm.money.desc: View, set, or add to a player's coin balance.
sre_commands.tmm.mood.name: Mood (SAN)
sre_commands.tmm.mood.desc: View or set a player's mood (Sanity) value, range 0.0~1.0.
sre_commands.tmm.autostart.name: Auto start
sre_commands.tmm.autostart.desc: Set a countdown (0~60s) to auto-start the game; 0 disables it.
sre_commands.tmm.votemap.name: Map vote
sre_commands.tmm.votemap.desc: Start a map vote and control it: view status, pause, resume, stop, or set a preset game mode.
sre_commands.tmm.switchmap.name: Switch map
sre_commands.tmm.switchmap.desc: Switch server maps: load, list, random, or scan all available maps.
sre_commands.tmm.fourthroom.name: Fourth room
sre_commands.tmm.fourthroom.desc: Manage the fourth-room card game: view status, play cards, buy items, end the turn, etc.
sre_commands.tmm.createpoint.name: Create waypoint
sre_commands.tmm.createpoint.desc: Create a waypoint at the given position, format path/name.
sre_commands.tmm.togglewaypoints.name: Toggle waypoints
sre_commands.tmm.togglewaypoints.desc: Admin control over waypoint visibility; toggle per player, per path, or globally.
sre_commands.tmm.showstats.name: View stats
sre_commands.tmm.showstats.desc: View your own game stats, or view others' (requires permission).
sre_commands.tmm.showselectedmapui.name: Show selected map UI
sre_commands.tmm.showselectedmapui.desc: Show the voting interface for the currently selected map.
sre_commands.tmm.netstats.name: Network stats (server)
sre_commands.tmm.netstats.desc: Server packet stats: start/stop/status/reset, global and per-player counts, packet ranking (by count/bytes/avg size), plus HTTP and SQL traffic stats (http/sql start|stop|status|reset|show, by endpoint and bytes), and export JSON to the server's netstats/ directory.
sre_commands.tmm.netstatsc.name: Network stats (client)
sre_commands.tmm.netstatsc.desc: Client packet stats: start/stop/status/reset, global and per-player counts, packet ranking (by count/bytes/avg size), plus HTTP traffic stats (http start|stop|status|reset|show, by endpoint and bytes), and export JSON to the .minecraft/netstats/ directory.
sre_commands.tmm.giveroomkey.name: Give room key
sre_commands.tmm.giveroomkey.desc: Give the executor a key item for the specified room.
sre_commands.tmm.participate.name: Participation
sre_commands.tmm.participate.desc: Manage participation in the next round: join, leave, toggle, or view status.
sre_commands.tmm.entity_interact_cmd.des: Attach custom persistent string data to the selected entity.
sre_commands.tmm.reload.name: Reload
sre_commands.tmm.reload.desc: Reload the default prep area or map vote config.
sre_commands.tmm.skinsync.name: Skin sync
sre_commands.tmm.skinsync.desc: Manage remote item-skin sync: configure the server, sync, pull, enable, or disable.
sre_commands.tmm.skins.name: Skins
sre_commands.tmm.skins.desc: Manage item skins and view the skins a player has equipped.
sre_commands.tmm.game.name: Game tools group
sre_commands.tmm.game.desc: Aggregate command group for in-game controls: visuals, timers, penalties, roles, events, etc.
sre_commands.forceteam.name: Force team
sre_commands.forceteam.desc: Force a player into a given team (Civilian / Neutral / Killer / Vigilante), or reset their team weights.
sre_commands.listgameroles.name: List game roles
sre_commands.listgameroles.desc: List every player's role and modifier for this round.
sre_commands.stop_when_over.name: Auto stop server
sre_commands.stop_when_over.desc: Toggle automatically shutting down the server when the game ends.
sre_commands.sre.narrator.name: Narrator
sre_commands.sre.narrator.desc: Send a TTS narration to the selected player; optionally interrupt the current announcement.
sre_commands.sre.custom_replay.name: Custom replay event
sre_commands.sre.custom_replay.desc: Record custom (or hidden) event markers in the game replay.
sre_commands.sre.show_replay.name: Show replay
sre_commands.sre.show_replay.desc: Show the generated game replay to a player.
sre_commands.sre.replay_screen.name: Replay screen
sre_commands.sre.replay_screen.desc: Manage the replay big screen: create, remove, list, set as default, or display.
sre_commands.sre.kick.name: Kick
sre_commands.sre.kick.desc: Kick the specified non-OP player, optionally with a reason.
sre_commands.sre.shield.name: Shield management
sre_commands.sre.shield.desc: Unified management of normal/timed/weak shields: sre:shield <normal|timed|weak> <add|set|get|clear> [args] [target]. Timed shields additionally take a duration (seconds) and whether to reset the timer and stack; weak shields additionally take a duration (seconds) and the death cause to block (* for any).
sre_commands.sre.poison.name: Poison management
sre_commands.sre.poison.desc: Apply/remove/trigger a player's poison or fake poison: sre:poison <normal|fake> <set|get|clear|trigger> [tick] [target]. set takes a number of game ticks (1s=20 ticks); clear removes it directly; trigger instantly activates the current poison and is fatal (fake poison is fatal too).
sre_commands.sre.stamina.name: Stamina
sre_commands.sre.stamina.desc: Add to or set a player's sprint stamina value.
sre_commands.sre.entitydisguise.name: Entity disguise
sre_commands.sre.entitydisguise.desc: Disguise a player entirely as any entity (model swap + eye height set to that entity's eye height, hitbox unchanged): sre:disguise start infinite <player> <entity type> [NBT]; or sre:disguise start <seconds> <player> <entity type> [NBT] for a timed disguise; sre:disguise clear <player> to remove; sre:disguise query <player> to query status (including remaining time). The appearance NBT is also the data source for /data and /execute if data: data sre:disguise <player> ...
sre_commands.sre.morph.name: Player morph
sre_commands.sre.morph.desc: Morph via MorphApi: sre:morph start infinite|<seconds> player <target> <player> (copy the target player's skin / hat / nametag / doll), random <player> (a random surviving player), texture <texture> <slim|wide> <player> (a custom texture, e.g. starrailexpress:textures/entity/disguise/disguise_skin_1.png); sre:morph clear <player> to remove; sre:morph clearall to clear everything; sre:morph query <player> to query the morph target and remaining time. Automatically cleared at game start/end.
sre_commands.sre.inventory.name: View inventory
sre_commands.sre.inventory.desc: View a target player's inventory in a GUI.
sre_commands.sre.invsee.name: View inventory (alias)
sre_commands.sre.invsee.desc: Alias of /sre:inventory; view a target player's inventory in a GUI.
sre_commands.sre.monitor.name: Security monitor
sre_commands.sre.monitor.desc: Search near a block and configure security camera positions.
sre_commands.sre.vote.name: Vote system
sre_commands.sre.vote.desc: A full in-game voting system: build options (player/text/item), start, pause, resume, stop, and read results.
sre_commands.sre.reloadroleconfig.name: Reload role config
sre_commands.sre.reloadroleconfig.desc: Reload all custom role configs and re-sync them to clients.
sre_commands.sre.area_manager.name: Area manager
sre_commands.sre.area_manager.desc: Manage per-map area config: spawn points, regions, environment, rooms; set/view/save/load/import map data.
sre_commands.sre.pass.name: Pass / team card
sre_commands.sre.pass.desc: Activate a team card / progression pass.
sre_commands.sre.roster.name: Role roster
sre_commands.sre.roster.desc: Open the role rotation roster; admins can edit, enable, disable, randomly draw, and view status.
sre_commands.sre.scene.name: Scene management
sre_commands.sre.scene.desc: Manage scene assets and scene config.
sre_commands.sre.camera.name: Advanced camera
sre_commands.sre.camera.desc: Advanced camera control for camera work and spectating.
sre_commands.sre.subtitle.name: Subtitle
sre_commands.sre.subtitle.desc: Show a subtitle at the center, top, or bottom of the screen.
sre_commands.sre.eggclear.name: Clear cuckoo eggs
sre_commands.sre.eggclear.desc: Clear Cuckoo egg entities within range.
sre_commands.sre.infected.name: Infection
sre_commands.sre.infected.desc: Set the duration (ticks) of a player's infection state.
sre_commands.sre.helium.name: Helium voice
sre_commands.sre.helium.desc: Apply a helium-voice effect to a player; optionally specify the duration in seconds.
sre_commands.sre.block_cmd_perm.name: Command block permission boost
sre_commands.sre.block_cmd_perm.desc: When enabled, raises the execution permission of command blocks and entity-interactive blocks to level 3 and persists it to config. Run with no args to view status.
sre_commands.tmm.game.visual.name: Visual effects
sre_commands.tmm.game.visual.desc: Toggle snow, sand, fog, HUD; set train speed and time; or reset all visual effects.
sre_commands.tmm.game.time.name: Game timer
sre_commands.tmm.game.time.desc: View or set the game countdown.
sre_commands.tmm.game.penalty.name: Death penalty
sre_commands.tmm.game.penalty.desc: Start or stop the death penalty; it can be bound to an entity or a position.
sre_commands.tmm.game.bounds.name: Bounds
sre_commands.tmm.game.bounds.desc: Toggle whether players are confined to the play bounds.
sre_commands.tmm.game.abilities.name: Abilities
sre_commands.tmm.game.abilities.desc: View or modify a target player's abilities (mayfly/flying/instabuild/invulnerable/flying_speed/walk_speed), or reset to defaults.
sre_commands.tmm.game.role.name: Role management
sre_commands.tmm.game.role.desc: In-game role tools: silently change, send welcome, sync roles, run/remove assignment events.
sre_commands.tmm.game.murder_time.name: Murder time event
sre_commands.tmm.game.murder_time.desc: The Murder-mode random time-event system: manage events, HUD, default pool, and triggers.
sre_commands.tmm.game.tests.name: Test tools
sre_commands.tmm.game.tests.desc: Test role mechanics, e.g. rain summoning, gambler card draws/miracles, and math problems.
sre_commands.tmm.game.tasks.name: Task queue
sre_commands.tmm.game.tasks.desc: Clear or cancel queued/list server tasks.
sre_commands.tmm.game.win.name: Trigger win
sre_commands.tmm.game.win.desc: Manually trigger the win condition; optionally use a custom color or fully custom text.
sre_commands.tmm.game.reset.name: Reset map
sre_commands.tmm.game.reset.desc: Reset map blocks (from backup or the simple method) and clear entities.
sre_commands.tmm.game.scan.name: Scan map
sre_commands.tmm.game.scan.desc: Scan and update map data, such as reset points and task points.
sre_commands.tmm.game.blackout.name: Blackout
sre_commands.tmm.game.blackout.desc: Trigger or stop the whole-map lights-out effect.
sre_commands.tmm.game.monitor_broken.des: Trigger or stop the security-monitor-broken effect.
sre_commands.tmm.game.psycho.name: Psycho effect
sre_commands.tmm.game.psycho.desc: Trigger or stop the psychological screen effect.
sre_commands.tmm.game.body.name: Corpse
sre_commands.tmm.game.body.desc: Spawn a corpse or run a command as a corpse.
sre_commands.tmm.game.revive.name: Revive
sre_commands.tmm.game.revive.desc: Revive a player at their corpse position or at given coordinates.
sre_commands.tmm.game.kill.name: Kill player
sre_commands.tmm.game.kill.desc: Kill a player with a specified death cause; optionally set the killer, whether to spawn a corpse, and force flags.
sre_commands.tmm.game.use_skill.name: Use skill
sre_commands.tmm.game.use_skill.desc: Server-side trigger of a role skill; optionally pick the skill index and target entity; use as <player> to specify the caster.
sre_commands.tmm.game.timestop.name: Time stop
sre_commands.tmm.game.timestop.desc: Start or stop the global time stop effect with a notification message.
sre_commands.changerole.name: Change role
sre_commands.changerole.desc: Change a player's role; control whether it is recorded in the replay and counted in stats.
sre_commands.changemodifier.name: Change modifier
sre_commands.changemodifier.desc: Add, remove, or toggle a modifier for a player.
sre_commands.forcerole.name: Force role
sre_commands.forcerole.desc: Force a player into a specified role on the next assignment.
sre_commands.forcemodifier.name: Force modifier
sre_commands.forcemodifier.desc: Force-assign a modifier to a player.
sre_commands.setrolecount.name: Set role count
sre_commands.setrolecount.desc: Override the automatically calculated Killer/Sheriff/Neutral counts, or reset to automatic.
sre_commands.setroleweight.name: Set role weight
sre_commands.setroleweight.desc: Set the spawn weight of a given role type.
sre_commands.myroleweight.name: My role weights
sre_commands.myroleweight.desc: View your own weights for each role.
sre_commands.playerroleweight.name: Player role weights
sre_commands.playerroleweight.desc: View or set a specified player's weights for each role.
sre_commands.togglecustomroleweights.des: Enable or disable the custom role weight system.
sre_commands.setoccupationrole.name: Set role pairing
sre_commands.setoccupationrole.desc: Set the paired-spawn relationship between two roles.
sre_commands.setenabledrole.name: Enable/disable role
sre_commands.setenabledrole.desc: Control which roles are available this round (enable all / disable all / one by one).
sre_commands.setenabledmodifier.name: Enable/disable modifier
sre_commands.setenabledmodifier.desc: Control which modifiers are available this round (enable all / disable all / one by one).
sre_commands.setcompanionrole.name: Set companion role
sre_commands.setcompanionrole.desc: Bind a main role to a companion role so they spawn as a pair.
sre_commands.listroles.name: List roles
sre_commands.managerolesui.name: Role management UI
sre_commands.managerolesui.desc: Open the role management GUI and view role/modifier details.
sre_commands.broadcast.name: Broadcast
sre_commands.broadcast.desc: Broadcast a formatted message to all players.
sre_commands.noellesroles.preset.name: Role preset
sre_commands.noellesroles.preset.desc: Save and apply role config presets: apply, list, create, delete, save.
sre_commands.noellesroles.setmax.name: Set role cap
sre_commands.noellesroles.setmax.desc: Set the maximum number of a given role allowed per round.
sre_commands.room.name: Room
sre_commands.stuck.name: Stuck rescue
sre_commands.stuck.desc: Teleport to a safe position when stuck inside blocks.
sre_commands.vt_mode.name: Streamer mode
sre_commands.vt_mode.desc: Toggle streamer (VTuber) mode for yourself or a player.
sre_commands.nr_free_cam.name: Free camera
sre_commands.nr_free_cam.desc: Exit the death penalty and restore free spectator camera.
sre_commands.displayitem.name: Display item
sre_commands.displayitem.desc: Show the info of the held item in the chat box.
sre_commands.cooldown.name: Cooldown
sre_commands.cooldown.desc: Set the cooldown time of an item skill for a player.
sre_commands.item.name: Extra items
sre_commands.item.desc: Manage players' extra item slots: add, set, view, remove.
sre_commands.goods.add.name: Add product
sre_commands.goods.add.desc: Add a vending-machine product at a given position and slot; optionally with a price.
sre_commands.goods.remove.name: Remove product
sre_commands.goods.remove.desc: Remove a vending-machine product at a given position and slot.
sre_commands.goods.list.name: List products
sre_commands.goods.list.desc: List the products configured at a given position.
sre_commands.repairshop.name: Repair shop
sre_commands.repairshop.desc: Open the shop management UI for repair mode.
sre_commands.repair.name: Start repair
sre_commands.repair.desc: Start repair mode; optionally specify the duration in minutes.
sre_commands.repairrole.name: Repair roles
sre_commands.repairrole.desc: Manage role assignment for repair mode: force, clear, unlock.
sre_commands.repairmap.name: Repair map
sre_commands.repairmap.desc: Manage repair-mode map data: repair locks and escape points (add/remove/list).
sre_commands.repairpreset.name: Repair preset
sre_commands.nametag.add.name: Add nametag
sre_commands.nametag.add.desc: Add a custom nametag to a player.
sre_commands.nametag.remove.name: Remove nametag
sre_commands.nametag.remove.desc: Remove a specified nametag from a player.
sre_commands.nametag.set.name: Set nametag
sre_commands.nametag.set.desc: Set a player's current nametag, replacing the existing one.
sre_commands.nametag.get.name: View nametag
sre_commands.nametag.list.name: List nametags
sre_commands.nametag.list.desc: List all of a player's nametags.
sre_commands.nametag.clear.name: Clear nametags
sre_commands.nametag.clear.desc: Clear all of a player's nametags.
sre_commands.nametag.sync.name: Sync nametags
sre_commands.nametag.sync.desc: Sync a player's nametags to all clients.
sre_commands.mw.reload.name: Reload whitelist
sre_commands.mw.maxplayers.name: Max players
sre_commands.mw.maxplayers.desc: View or set the server's maximum player count.
sre_commands.sre.client.name: Client settings
sre_commands.sre.client.desc: Client-side commands for local settings, UI, and config (run only on the client).
sre_commands.sreclient.scene.name: Client scene
sre_commands.sreclient.scene.desc: Client-side scene asset commands (run only on the client).
sre_commands.kill.name: Kill (overridden)
sre_commands.kill.desc: Vanilla /kill is Mixin-overridden: players require permission level 3, command blocks require level 2.
sre.give.name: Give custom content
sre.give.desc: Give a custom train item or custom block: /sre:give [player] item|block <id>[components] [count]; items support vanilla component syntax; omit the player to give it to yourself.
sre.setblock.name: Place custom block
sre.setblock.desc: Place a custom block at the given coordinates: /sre:setblock <coords> <id> [facing].
sre.clone.name: Clone area
sre.clone.desc: Clone an entire region (including block entities and custom block ids), finished chunk by chunk per tick: /sre:clone <from1> <from2> <to>.
sre.reload.custom_roles.name: Reload custom roles
sre.reload.custom_roles.desc: Reload only the custom role configs and sync them to clients.
sre.reload.custom_modifiers.name: Reload custom modifiers
sre.reload.custom_modifiers.desc: Reload only the custom modifier configs and sync them to clients.
sre.reload.custom_items.name: Reload custom items
sre.reload.custom_items.desc: Reload only the custom train item configs and sync them to clients.
sre.reload.custom_blocks.name: Reload custom blocks
sre.reload.custom_blocks.desc: Reload only the custom block configs and sync them to clients.
sre.reload.name: Reload all custom content
sre.reload.desc: With no subcommand, reloads all custom content (train items / blocks / roles / modifiers); you can also reload just one category.
